messages.subject: Areal Mean
parts:
Dear users,

I start using R and I would like help on the my problem. I have monthly data of 31  years which is precip, lat and lon. The data is global. But I like to get time series on the area[ lon 33 to 48 and lat 3 to 48]. Please would u help me. Thank you.

Sincerely,

Bedassa

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Areal Mean
parts:
You could use use geom_tile to plot squares that represent your Lat x Lon locations, and then facet_wrap to go through the months. 

ggplot(data = data, aes(x = Long, y = Lat, fill = rainfall)+
geom_tile()+
facet_wrap(.~Month)

You could plot is on a map as well using the same basic idea.
